verdict.rationale: Deel documents an official MCP server exposing tools (createTimeOffRequest, listOfContracts, calculateEorVersusEntityHiringCosts) with OAuth2 handled by clients like Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and ChatGPT, confirmed by docs and a probe of the live MCP introduction page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of the MCP server actually working in production beyond vendor docs.
